title: Port Phillip Bay benthic habitat monitoring: classification, validation, QA and dashboard code (2016–2025)
description: Code and derived data supporting an uncertainty-aware decadal benthic habitat monitoring framework for Port Phillip Bay, Australia (2016–2025), including Google Earth Engine classification and dashboard code, polygon-blocked cross-validation, independent validation inputs, annual habitat areas, turbidity analysis inputs, compositing sensitivity outputs, and classification-persistence products.
